opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to configure MetaMask for Fantom, deploy a contract on the FTM chain, and fund that contract so it can perform rapid arbitrage trades. The speaker expressly says, "Now I need to supply this contract slash coin with enough gas to be able to arbitrage, trade back and forth with itself," then describes sending 98 FTM to the contract. The promised mechanism is tied to flash-loan trading, which the speaker says generates profits through rapid back-and-forth transactions. After the demonstration, the speaker characterizes the displayed result as "$1,400." The description then raises the required funding substantially, stating "APPROX 500 FTM TO EARN MORE THAN THE AMOUNT IN THE VIDEO," presenting a large contract transfer as the condition for pursuing greater returns.
